title: Time to make a lesson
detail: Reading a phone-style photo took 5 s on average (5 pages); simplifying with Fact Guard took 22 s (2 pages), including waits for free-tier rate limits. Adapting one page by hand for three kinds of learner takes a teacher far longer (measure it on-site with a stopwatch).
dataset: Fresh uploads of phone-photo-degraded OpenStax pages (no cache)
method: Wall-clock time of the API calls on the free tiers
